questions.question: In the text, what does the phrase "profit‑taking" mean?
options: Investors are selling stocks to lock in gains
questions.explain_en: Profit‑taking means investors sell shares after prices have risen to secure their profits.
questions.explain_zh: 「profit‑taking」指的是投資人在股價上漲後賣出股票，鎖定獲利。
questions.news_title_en: TAIEX tumbles 589 points Friday as chip and electronics stocks retreat

questions.question: By how many points did the TAIEX fall on that Friday?
questions.explain_en: The summary states the benchmark TAIEX fell 589.33 points.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說明台股指數當天下跌了 589.33 點。
questions.news_title_en: TAIEX tumbles 589 points Friday as chip and electronics stocks retreat

questions.question: In the text, what does the word "bottlenecks" mean?
options: Obstacles that slow down a process
Things that speed up a process
questions.explain_en: "Bottlenecks" are obstacles that limit speed or capacity, as used for AI computing limits.
questions.explain_zh: 「bottlenecks」指的是阻礙或限制速度、容量的障礙，在文中指 AI 計算的限制。
questions.news_title_en: Silicon photonics pushes chips into the "light era"

questions.question: How much money has Nvidia committed to optical interconnect and silicon‑photonics supply chains in recent months?
questions.explain_en: The summary states Nvidia has committed more than US$6 billion.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說明 Nvidia 最近幾個月投入超過 60 億美元於光互連與矽光子供應鏈。
questions.news_title_en: Silicon photonics pushes chips into the "light era"

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "solvency" mean?
options: The speed at which a company can grow
The number of customers a company has
The ability to pay debts and meet financial obligations
The amount of profit a company makes
questions.explain_en: Solvency refers to an insurer's ability to meet its long‑term financial obligations.
questions.explain_zh: 「solvency」指的是保險公司能否長期償付其財務義務。
questions.news_title_en: FSC readies eight new rules for 2026 as life insurers face major transition

questions.question: When will the eight new regulatory measures take effect?
questions.explain_en: The summary states the measures are taking effect next year, i.e., in 2026.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說明這八項新規則將於明年（2026 年）生效。
questions.news_title_en: FSC readies eight new rules for 2026 as life insurers face major transition

questions.question: What does the word "ecosystem" mean as used in the text?
questions.explain_en: In the article, "ecosystem" refers to the whole system of companies, services, and regulations that work together.
questions.explain_zh: 在文中，「ecosystem」指的是相互作用的公司、服務與規範所構成的整體系統。
questions.news_title_en: Banks eye private markets and family offices, urge wider alternatives access

questions.question: What rule do Taiwanese bankers want regulators to ease?
options: The minimum capital requirement for banks
The limit on foreign exchange trading
questions.explain_en: The summary says they urge regulators to ease the 99‑investor cap on private funds.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中提到他們要求放寬對私募基金的99位投資人上限規定。
questions.news_title_en: Banks eye private markets and family offices, urge wider alternatives access

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "succession" mean?
options: A legal penalty for tax evasion
The process of passing on assets after someone dies
questions.explain_en: Here "succession" refers to the transfer of property or rights after a person’s death.
questions.explain_zh: 這裡的「succession」指的是人在過世後財產或權利的繼承。
questions.news_title_en: Estate and gift tax act amended, tightening pre-death transfers

questions.question: When were the amendments to the Estate and Gift Tax Act announced?
questions.explain_en: The summary states the president promulgated the amendments on September 11, 2026.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說明總統於2026年9月11日頒布了修正案。
questions.news_title_en: Estate and gift tax act amended, tightening pre-death transfers

questions.question: In the summary, what does the word "peg" mean?
questions.explain_en: Here "peg" means to set the CPI at a fixed level of 2.03%.
questions.explain_zh: 這裡的「peg」是指把 CPI 固定在 2.03% 的水平。
questions.news_title_en: Central bank holds rates, lifts 2026 growth forecast to 11.48%

questions.question: What is the central bank's forecast for Taiwan's GDP growth in 2026?
questions.explain_en: The summary states the bank raised its 2026 GDP growth forecast to 11.48%.
questions.explain_zh: 摘要中說明央行把 2026 年 GDP 成長預測提升至 11.48%。
questions.news_title_en: Central bank holds rates, lifts 2026 growth forecast to 11.48%
